image_description: A white minibus driving on a city street, angled slightly towards the left. The vehicle features a prominent front grille with red and yellow stripes, a digital destination sign reading '201 TOWER', and an open sliding door on the passenger side. The background shows blurred urban buildings.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic compact, high-roof profile of a minibus, distinct from larger transit buses.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large single-pane windshield is visible, and multiple side windows are clearly defined along the body.

The door panel is visibly recessed into the body cavity, indicating a sliding mechanism, and is currently in the open position.
The short hood and front grille assembly indicate a conventional front-engine layout typical of this class of vehicle.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is outside the frame of the image.

The overall dimensions and window configuration align with the capacity constraints of a minibus.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the green destination header ('201 TOWER') is legible but exhibits slight character warping and uneven kerning. The license plate contains illegible, gibberish characters typical of AI generation.
The interior floor/step area within the open doorway lacks clear geometric definition. It appears to melt into the shadow without a distinct edge or structural support, creating a spatial ambiguity.
The side mirror assembly appears slightly fused with the door frame, lacking a crisp separation line between the moving part and the static body.
